steps.text:
Your approved C2 change is committed (`f64a851`, PB-01 back to Ready then). Your list is now in `probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/delisted.csv`, but not in `out/` as you asked: `out/` is for private files, and I never read or write anything there. You shared the list here, so it isn't private, and it sits beside the script as a committed input. Moving it changed both probes' code, so PB-01 and PB-02 are back to Draft until you approve. That isn't committed yet.

## The start dates
LOAD-06 checks when each name was **in the S&P 500**: the start is the date it joined the index, and the end is the date it left. Your dates are delisting dates. They work as end dates, since the index removal is usually within a few days of the delisting, and C6 allows 3. As start dates they would make every name fail.

**So I left `start` blank for all 10, and C6 checks only the end dates and records the start dates Sharadar shows.** If you know the dates they joined the index, give them to me and I'll fill them in. Most of these names were members before 2000, so the start the data shows may simply be its earliest date.

The file now holds:
```
ticker,start,end
BUD,,2008-11-18
DNA,,2009-03-26
WB,,2008-12-31
LEH,,2008-09-17
BSC,,2008-05-30
CFC,,2008-07-01
MER,,2009-01-01
SGP,,2009-11-03
WYE,,2009-10-15
EK,,2012-01-19
```

## What changed

| Check | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| PB-01 C6 | Read `out/delisted.csv`; start and end within 3 days | Reads the committed `delisted.csv`; the end within 3 days, and the start too where one is given. It records how many starts were given |
| PB-02 C4 | Read PB-01's `out/delisted.csv` | Reads PB-01's `delisted.csv` |

- The new hashes are PB-01 `f4ed09f2` and PB-02 `dd01d1b6`. What the probes spend hasn't changed.
- I removed the guard that stopped `history` when the list was missing, since the list now ships with the code.
- PB-02's C1–C3 results are cleared. They belonged to the old code, so `public.py all` has to run again; from my connection it only gets 429s, so it needs yours.

## ASSUMPTIONS
- **Ticker matching:** C6 matches your tickers exactly as Sharadar's S&P 500 table writes them. If Sharadar gives a reused ticker a suffix (for example, Genentech's old `DNA`), C6 will show that name as not found, and we'll see it in the counts.
- **Your plan's tables:** still unconfirmed, as you said. The rerun's C2 counts each full-download file's rows, which answers it from the data.

## Open question
Do you know the dates these 10 joined the S&P 500? If not, the blank starts stay, and LOAD-06's start-date part stays unchecked until you do.

## Your steps after you approve

| Command | Time |
|---|---|
| `python3 probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/probe.py check` | < 1 min |
| `python3 probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/probe.py history` | A few minutes |
| `python3 probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/probe.py bulk` | Up to an hour or so |
| `uv run probes/PB-02-yahoo-coverage/public.py all` | About 5 min |
| `uv run probes/PB-02-yahoo-coverage/probe.py universe` | 15–30 min |
